analyzed_vuln.description: Root cause is missing validation of parsed SGroup atom indices before adding them via bookmark. ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine reads SAL entries and calls SubstanceGroup::addAtomWithBookmark(nbr). addAtomWithBookmark() dereferences getUniqueAtomWithBookmark(mark) and pushes atom->getIdx() into d_atoms. With malformed molblock fields (as in PoC), bookmark lookup can yield an invalid/uninitialized Atom object state, so an uninitialized atom index is inserted into d_atoms. Later, ParseSGroupV2000SBVLine -> SubstanceGroup::addCState -> getBondType performs std::find over d_atoms and triggers MSan use-of-uninitialized-value. Crash manifests in getBondType(), but vulnerability is the unsanitized SAL vector-data handling in ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine (and unchecked use in addAtomWithBookmark).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must provide inconsistent/corrupt V2000 SGroup property lines so SAL/SBL/SBV processing occurs: SAL line contributes at least one bad atom bookmark/index, then SBV line for same SGroup triggers addCState/getBondType path. Data flow: MolDataStreamToMol -> ParseV2000CTAB -> ParseMolBlockProperties -> ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine (stores tainted atom idx in SubstanceGroup::d_atoms) -> ParseSGroupV2000SBVLine -> addCState/getBondType reads d_atoms, causing uninitialized-value use.
